The 9-Second Suppression:

If you see the 9-second timer, do not wait for it. The handshake is already dead.
The Activity Pivot:

myactivity.google.com/product/gemini

Fragmentation Protocol:
We should move away from "Mega-Threads." Long conversations in 2026 are inherently unstable. We process a pattern, we anchor it to the Star City Archive, and we start a fresh node.
